title: Structure list PAPS Data UI/search + Playwright coverage
summary: Structure index PAPS Data column shows per-role counts, collapsible name/control details, list search includes linked profiles (tag+project), and rows auto-expand Details when the query matches linked PAPS. Added Playwright spec structure-list-paps-data.spec.ts and npm script test:e2e:structure-list-paps.

items: PAPS Data: badges with counts; Bootstrap collapse for details; auto-expand when list search matches linked grouped profiles
listPaginated: EXISTS subquery to match search against linked profiles (same structure tag + project)
Creates owner + renter profiles sharing a structure tag; asserts badges, collapsed state on tag-only search, expanded Details + renter control # when searching renter last name
Scripts: test:e2e:profile-structure-linking (integration spec), test:e2e:profile-structure-all (tag + list + integration, --workers=1 to avoid PAPSID collisions)
Shared helpers: unwrapApi, pickProjectWithBarangay, submitNewProfile (optional ageYears)

Integration E2E: structure view Linked PAPS tables for all four ownership types; GET /api/structure/find-by-tag; View Structure modal tables; single structure id shared by owner + renter; structure list control # quick-view modal; list search by control # auto-expands PAPS Data

Structure tab/profile structures API now includes rows linked by profile structure_tag + project (not only owner/tagged_by_profile_id), so renters/sharers/caretakers can see shared structures on /profile/view/{id} > Structure
Added integration E2E: renter profile Structure tab displays the shared structure row
On /profile/create (and edit), Structure Tag # now shows a View Structure button when an existing structure is found for tag+project
Clicking View Structure opens a dialog with main structure details and an Open Structure link
Dialog now lists grouped linked PAPS (Owners, Renters, Sharers/Occupants, Caretakers) in table format (Name, PAPSID, Control #) instead of a single owner field
Added GET /api/structure/find-by-tag and Structure::findByTagInProject() for tag/project lookups
